eligibility.status: final (backlog items are stored but never selectable)

directRemediation.fieldForWeaknessSession: current fieldId of the mapped Level2 question
directRemediation.firstChoice: Use the direct Level2 if unseen, or if it is not among the last 3 presentations in that field.
directRemediation.recentDirectFallback: Choose from the same current field using the normal rotation.

rotation.rule: Prefer questions not yet presented in the current rotation cycle.
rotation.afterCycleExhaustion: Refill from all eligible questions, but do not immediately repeat the last question.
rotation.currentStreakDistinctness: Never present a questionId already counted in the current qualifying streak.
rotation.wrongOrAssistedAnswer: Reset the qualifying streak, but keep attempt history and continue the rotation.
rotation.shortageBehavior: Practice may continue with the available questions using rotation, but mastery remains unavailable until the field has at least 4 eligible distinct questions.

priority: unseen active-original or unresolved official past-paper questionId
previously-correct official past-paper only when needed to keep four distinct questions
hardRules: Never immediately repeat the same questionId.
A valid 4/4 mastery streak must contain 4 distinct questionIds.
A wrong answer resets currentStreak to 0 but never deletes history.
Using a hint, explanation, or revealing the answer before the first answer resets currentStreak to 0.
Category changes never change questionId, seen status, or past attempts.
Only items explicitly listed in masteryEligibleQuestionIds may count toward that field's 4/4.
Do not count a quadratic-equation item as factorization mastery merely because factorization is one possible solution method.
If a field has fewer than 4 mastery-eligible unique questions, allow practice but do not award 4/4 mastery.

backlog.rule: L2 questions derived from 2019-2021 remain stored with immutable IDs, content, figures, and history but are excluded from every active pool and direct-open route.
backlog.reactivation: Reactivate one question at a time only after content, figure, answer, standalone-scope, and grading review. A material rewrite receives a new immutable questionId.

officialPastPapers.identity: Use canonical official IDs such as 2021-Q5-1, never the backlog L2 ID.
officialPastPapers.display: Render the verified crop from the official question page.
officialPastPapers.history: Official attempts are independent of backlog Level2 attempts. Full-year scores are never retroactively changed.
officialPastPapers.reuse: A correct official question is deprioritized, not permanently deleted; it may return after other questions when required to preserve a four-distinct-question streak.

fieldSemantics.weaknessField: Use the current primary fieldId of the direct Level2 item.
fieldSemantics.directFieldPractice: Use all items whose practiceFieldIds contains the selected field.
fieldSemantics.secondaryPracticeItem: Counts normally for the selected field's streak because it was explicitly tagged as testing that field's skill; its primary category and history remain unchanged.

supportQuestions.behavior: support questions participate in the same shuffle-bag and streak rules as core questions
supportQuestions.sourceWeaknessDirectLink: support questions are never used as the direct source-question counterpart
supportQuestions.history: stored under their own immutable SUP-* questionId
